entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: Initial state where no procedure transaction is active between network and UE.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING
entities.description: State where network has initiated a procedure transaction towards the UE and is awaiting response.

entities.name: network initiated 5GSM procedure command
entities.description: Condition triggered when network sends a 5GSM procedure command to initiate transaction.

entities.name: 5GSM procedure response by the UE
entities.description: Condition triggered when UE sends a response to complete the procedure transaction.

relations.description: Network initiated 5GSM procedure command transitions state from INACTIVE to PENDING.
UE response to 5GSM procedure transitions state from PENDING back to INACTIVE.
State transition from INACTIVE to PENDING triggered by network initiation.
State transition from PENDING to INACTIVE triggered by UE response.
